title: Camaro Z/28 in the Night Studio Above the City
label: MIDNIGHT GARAGE
statement: Show up tired. Show up anyway.
description:
Welcome to the Night Studio Above the City, where a chalk grey 1969 Chevrolet Camaro Z/28 rests peacefully while the city glitters far below and the screens glow low. All around you, two hours of calm ambient electronic music fill the air with warm synth pads, a soft deep bass, and a gentle beat. It is a serene space of music only, perfect to keep you company while you work, study, or relax.

No talking. No lyrics. No sudden sounds. Every track is original, made for CEO Focus.

CEO Focus | Dream Cars. Easy Listening.
